label: early-episode rewarded a2 streak: D1/GO before choosing a2 again after a reward
explanation: Fires only at D1 and GO (never D2), only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1, 100% of mass) and the agent is about to choose a2 (99.97% of mass; essentially zero when the previous or upcoming choice is a1), and only in the first ~30 trials of an episode (no activation at all after trial ~35). GO carries 86% of mass; D1 activations are weaker and vanish earlier (~trial 15), hence the split ep_trial cut. Within its support, magnitude is largest at the start of a rewarded a2 run and decays across successive rewarded a2 trials and over episode time; it tracks a strongly negative policy logit (choice < -8.9 holds 69% of mass) and mid-high value. Does not fire after unrewarded trials, after a1 choices, at D2, or late in the episode. The upcoming action is a FUTURE variable but is the agent own choice (legitimate); the observed-only version using prev_action!=1 instead of action==2 at GO scores F1 0.65 vs 0.72. Precision is limited (~0.6) because the early-episode gating is soft: many matching steps, especially after long rewarded streaks, stay below threshold.
